notes: Native Add writes the indexed registry and model owner before querying DoesBlockTouch, then appends to the appropriate list. Clear clears both indexed registry and owner before querying DoesBlockTouch and removing the first list occurrence. Above/below membership uses the exact same native +0x408 DoesBlockTouch virtual as HasTouchBlockingItem; the earlier IsAboveItem interpretation was incorrect. Repeated registration is deliberately not deduplicated. The cell passes its own identity explicitly instead of storing a duplicate mediator owner field.

Fixed twenty-entry storage follows the recovered enum values without reflection/Enum.GetNames. Touch and fall now share the same mediator lists. Existing touch-only fixtures remain supported; fall requires a typed static-fall capability.

IsAvailableForFall short-circuits fallability, view swapping, current-cell existence and touch-blocking above-list DoesBlockFall. The destination argument is unused. Current/next honey and roof queries and current-only spreading follow native order. Normal match/special capabilities are true; box fallability is false.

Cell.IsFallBlocked retains distinct default and incoming-exploder branches; fixed blocking types take priority over chain remaining count. Extra neighbor propeller-combo count remains an explicitly required typed service. Unchecked signed subtraction matches ARM32 overflow.

FallAnimationStarted re-reads its delegate, casts slot 7 to the roof owner, queries the below neighbor even when no current roof was found, and notifies only at the coverage boundary. Native invalid casts and partial callback failures are retained. Under-static state stores before current/atlas/by-cell/reverse/sorting/update calls; default point is (9,11).

Actual normal MatchItemPrefab view now directly implements IOriginalFallItemView, clears highlight before setting under-static, forwards roof notification through the controller, and uses original inherited atlas -1/by-cell false/reverse false/default order 1000. Base FallStarted/FallEnded are empty in native. Recycle clears the model delegate at the existing native location.

Native differential comparison passes 470 sequences /6620 commands with exact storage and callback traces including injected failures. Metadata/CLR lists, mediation getters, neighbor lookup, concrete roof-notification behavior, sorting-manager responses and extra exploder counting are boundaries. Concrete static constructors/factory/lifecycle and full roof damage/visuals are not restored by these tests.

Unity fall-motion diagnostic uses actual normal item availability against real match/current-cell/static registry state. Pooled-prefab presentation passes 200 Unity frames /two reuse cycles using the actual view directly rather than a fall-view adapter; it verifies once-only roof notification, under-static highlight clearing/default sorting, masks and full squash/bounce/rest state. Application-owned motion clock/grid/SFX/context lookup, fall manager startup and player-driven resolution/refill/cascade composition remain pending. No rendered-original pixel parity is claimed.

One callback-controller allocation per pooled view and one twenty-reference static registry array per cell are initialization costs. Per-frame queries allocate no managed objects; list scans short-circuit and no hierarchy search is added.

Existing Unity match-presentation regression passes after fall controller model binding and recycle delegation changes, including merge/explode/reset and actual pooled instance reuse. No production composition claim is made.

Native Sorting.GetCrossSorting 0x12d81cc short-circuits current then next touch blockers, returning item layer /1550 when blocked and /7000 otherwise, SortEverything=true.
